title: Todos Create Handler Permission Consistency

migration.reason: The existing fair_crm.todos.create permission is reused.

backend.reason: Existing todo create authorization remains unchanged and authoritative.

audit.reason: Existing todo create auditing remains unchanged.

menu.reason: No navigation menu changes are introduced.

route_guard.reason: The todos route remains readable; only create mutation handling is hardened.

notes: TodosPage already hid create UI without fair_crm.todos.create, but handleCreate itself could invoke createTodo without an explicit fail-closed guard. The handler now returns immediately when create permission is absent. Todo step replacement has a separate fair_crm.todos.update contract and is intentionally outside this focused handler-hardening change.
